ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 2:3 ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black region centered at the notch and extending to the leading and trailing edges. Two large, asymmetrical high-intensity white fields occupy the lateral lobes, with significant micro-mottling and stippling at the pigmentation boundaries.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 115 degrees and a shallow depth relative to the total fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern; distal edges of both lobes exhibit higher frequency micro-notches (3-5 pixels depth) compared to the smoother proximal edges near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the distal leading edges transitioning to a concave sweep along the mid-trailing edge toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Discrete clusters of circular high-intensity pixels (approx. 5-10 clusters) located primarily on the lower-central dark pigmentation field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible dark-tone linear streaks on the right lobe white field, appearing as 3-4 parallel lines; similar isolated dark linear interruption on the left lobe distal white region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Likely rake marks (parallel linear scars) on the right lobe; scattered circular depigmentation spots indicative of previous sessile organism attachment.
